metadata.name: Chemical and Age Measurements of Sediment Core LTp22-1
metadata.description: This dataset contains chemical measurements (Si, K, Ca, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ge, Sr, Zr, Cd, Ce, Ta) and age data (Age, Age_2) from a sediment core sample (LTp22-1) collected at a specific location (21.277661, -104.690167) on April 8, 2022. The data includes depth measurements and event identifiers.
